get_smartphone_apps.metaDescription: List installable apps on a smartphone device for V2 or classic test authoring. Copy `package` to `starting.app`, the app to `meta`.

build_campaign.metaDescription: Build a runnable campaign from exactly one source, test_ids or test_campaign_id. An ephemeral batch of tests, discarded after the run and never saved.

run_campaign.metaDescription: Execute a campaign and wait for results. Blocks until completion and returns per-test results.

get_monitor.metaDescription: Get the full configuration of a monitor: owners, input_variables, scheduling, variable_group, and status.

overview.description: Explore all 105 Kapptivate MCP tools across 17 categories, covering discovery, testing, monitoring, alerting, and dashboards.
